source: 764 There’s Always a Corruption That Can Be Used
target: 764: Semper est corruptio, quae adhiberi potest.

source: 764 There’s Always a Corruption That Can Be Used
target: 764: Semper est corruptio, quae adhiberi potest.

source: Lumian took off his glasses and whispered, “The target should have noticed something unusual about me, but Ludwig is right beside me, giving off the ‘mother’ aura from that corpse.
target: Lumian oculos vitreos sustulit et susurravit: “Scopus debuit aliquid insolitum de me animadvertere, sed Ludwig stat iuxta me, ex illo cadavere ‘mater’ auram emittens.

source: With both of these factors together, the target will surely be highly suspicious and may seek assistance.
target: Cum his duobus factoribus simul, scopus certe erit suspiciosus et auxilium quaerere possit.

source: Be prepared.
target: Estote parati.

source: If it were just the Omebella bloodline alone, Oxyto might think it was merely the law of convergence at work, bringing the blasphemer of the Child of God into her presence.
target: Si sola stirps Omebellae esset, Oxyto forsitan putaret id solum esse legem convergenceis in actu, quae blasphemetorem Filii Dei in praesentiam eius adduceret.

source: Similarly, if it were just the ‘mother’ aura from the corpse, she might become wary or suspect that the corpse’s return to the earth had contaminated the local water, leading to the corruption of certain individuals.
target: Similiter, si sola aura “mater” ex cadavere esset, illa fortasse cauta esset aut suspicaret reditum cadaveris in terram aquas locales contaminavisse, quod corruptionem quarundam inferret.

source: But put together, anyone who could sense these would immediately see there was a big problem.
target: Sed simul, quisquis haec sentire posset, statim agnosceret magnum esse problema.

source: This couldn’t just be a coincidence; there was clearly a dangerous trap!
target: Hoc non esset solum fortuita coincidentia; perspicue erat insidia periculosa!

source: Knight of Swords Maric’s voice seemed to come from farther away.
target: Vox Equitis Gladii Maric videbatur ex longinquo provenire.

source: “We’re already ready.”
target: “Iam parati sumus.”

source: Sensing the hidden danger and preparing even before I thought through everything and issued a reminder? They have strong spiritual intuition and rich experience… Lumian mused as he noticed Lugano, startled by his movements and deep voice, also standing up.
target: Percipiens periculum occultum et praeparans iam, antequam omnia meditarem et admonitionem edicerem? Habent validam spiritualem intuitionem atque copiam experientiae… meditatus Lumian animadvertit Lugano, motibus suis atque voce profunda commotum, qui quoque surrexit.

source: Ludwig wasted no time in pulling the ice cream they had abandoned closer to him and happily ate away, completely unconcerned about what might happen next.
target: Ludwig nihil moratus est: gelatum, quod reliquerant, ad se traxit et laete comedebat, omnino de futuris eventibus non sollicitus.

source: Lumian’s gaze swept over Lugano and Ludwig before moving to Franca and Jenna, who were enjoying their dessert.
target: Aspectus Lumiani percurrit Lugano et Ludwig, deinde ad Francam et Jennam, quae dulcia edebant.

source: He was now considering a critical question:
target: Iam quaestionem gravem considerabat:

source: Should they act together, or separate like they did in the morning?
target: Num simul agere debeant, an ut mane seorsim agerent?

source: If the earlier speculations were broadly accurate, then the bait phase to lure out Oxyto should already be over.
target: Si praecedentes coniecturae late verae fuerunt, tempus allicii ad Oxyto extrahendum iam peractum debebat.

source: What lay ahead would likely be probing attacks from the Shaman King and her companions.
target: Quod sequentia erant, probabiliter, essent impetus inquirendi a Regina Scamanorum et comitibus eius.

source: In that case, moving together would allow them to better receive protection from the temperance faction, without worrying that Oxyto might strike at a less guarded spot and capture one or two as hostages.
target: In hoc casu, simul moveri illis sineret melius tutelam a factione temperantiae recipere, sine sollicitudine ne Oxyto in loco minus munito feriret ictum et unum vel duo captivis haberet.

source: But if the attack was fierce enough to force the temperance faction’s hidden forces into a defensive position, staying together could lead to total annihilation.
target: Sed si impetus satis ferox esset ut copias occultas factionis temperantiae in positionem defensionis cogerent, simul manere ad exitium totum ducere posset.

source: Which choice was safer and more reasonable in this environment was a decision the team leader needed to make.
target: Quae optio tutior et magis rationabilis in hoc ambitu esset, id decernere duce turmae incumbebat.

source: Lumian walked slowly toward the restaurant’s entrance, mentally filtering through the questions and speculations he’d considered earlier.
target: Lumian lente ad ostium cauponae processit, quaestiones et speculationes antea in mente meditatas revidens.

source: He thought of his own description of the spirit realm in Raklev:
target: Meminit propriam descriptionem regni spirituum in Raklev:

source: A rudimentary, localized Underworld.
target: Orbis inferni rudimentarius et in loco limitatus.

source: Underworld… Lumian’s eyelids twitched, and he quietly asked again, “Can any of you see or sense the Underworld?”
target: Infernum… Palpebra Lumiani concitata sunt, atque ille tacite iterum rogavit: “Num quis vestrum infernum videre aut sentire potest?”

source: He was asking whether Zombies and Wraiths could detect the Underworld.
target: Rogabat an mortui ambulantes et umbrae infernum deprehendere possent.

source: Knight of Swords Maric quickly answered, “No, unless someone directly opens the door to the Underworld or is already from there. Otherwise, it can only be sensed through certain traces.
target: Eques Gladii Maric celeriter respondit, “Non, nisi aliquis ianuam directe ad infernum aperiat aut ex eo iam proveniat. Aliter, tantum per quaedam vestigia deprehendi potest.

source: “Before the Underworld anomaly, it was possible.”
target: “Ante anomaliam inferni, id fieri poterat.”

source: It was possible before the Underworld anomaly? Is this inferred from ancient records?
target: Potestne hoc fuisse ante anomaliam inferni? Num hoc ex antiquis documentis deducitur?

source: Lumian wasn’t particularly concerned about this; instead, he was more interested in something else:
target: Lumian hoc non valde curabat; potius aliud eum magis occupabat:

source: If Oxyto has indeed begun integrating the local spirit realm into her Paramita, does that mean her Paramita qualifies as a small-scale Underworld?
target: Si Oxyto vere coepit regnum spirituum localem in Paramita sua integrare, num illa Paramita ut parvus orbis inferni consideranda sit?

source: Moreover, it had to be a small-scale Underworld that was still bound to this region.
target: Praeterea, debebat esse infernum parvum, quod adhuc huic regione alligatus esset.

source: Otherwise, based on Lumian’s understanding of Paramita, Oxyto could have easily taken her Paramita away and left the area.
target: Alioquin, secundum intellectum Lumiani de Paramita, Oxyto facile illam Paramita abducere potuisset et regionem relinquere.

source: Of course, it’s also possible that she hadn’t achieved another goal yet.
target: Certe, etiam possibile est quod alia propositum nondum perficeret.

source: A small-scale Underworld… Lumian muttered to himself and then walked toward Franca and Jenna, smiling as he said, “I heard Chaban Street is unique to this area. Would you two lovely ladies like to be my guides?”
target: Infernum parvum… Lumian sibi submurmuravit et deinde ad Francam et Jennam ambulavit, subridente dicens: “Audivi viam Chaban huic regione unicam esse. Velitisne, o pulcherrimae mulieres, mihi duces esse?”

source: Chaban Street was where Franca and Jenna had first noticed the temperature drop slightly, indicating that they might have encountered Oxyto there.
target: Via Chaban erat locus in quo Franca et Jenna primum animadvertēbant levem lapsum temperiei, quod indicabat fortasse ibi Oxyto occurrisse.

source: In the eyes of the nearby customers, Lumian’s invitation was a blatant attempt to arrange a date. However, Franca and Jenna exchanged a glance and understood that Lumian was suggesting they should act together, with Chaban Street as their destination.
target: In oculis clientium proximorum, invitatio Lumiani manifesta erat conatus ad conventum amoris ordinandum. Attamen, Franca et Jenna oculos inter se commutaverunt et intellexerunt Lumian eos simul agere, Via Chaban destinata servare.

source: “Sure.” Franca and Jenna smiled in unison and stood up.
target: “Certe.” Franca et Jenna simul subriserunt et surrexerunt.

source: This left those around them somewhat stunned:
target: Hoc reliquit eos circumstantes paulo attonitos:

source: Are they that easy to invite?
target: Suntne illae tam facile invitandae?

source: If I’d known, I would have plucked up the courage to ask!
target: Si id scivissem, animum ad rogandum colligerem!

source: Together, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and the others strolled toward Chaban Street, exchanging relaxed remarks about their impressions of the city.
target: Simul, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et alii ad Via Chaban ambulaverunt, inter se leviter de impressionibus urbis sermones commutantes.

source: About fifteen minutes later, they reached the street predominantly occupied by locals.
target: Circiter quindecim minutis post, viam attigerunt, quae praecipue incolis frequentabatur.

source: Gray-white stone houses stood in rows, appearing rugged yet solid.
target: Domus lapideae cinereo-albae in ordines steterunt, aspicientes asperae sed robustae.

source: Outside each house, strips of wool hung, adding a vibrant, exotic touch that distinguished it from the Star Highlands.
target: Extra singulas domos, fascias lanae pendent, addentes notam vibrantem atque exoticam, quae eam ab Alpibus Stellatis distinguebatur.

source: Compared to other streets in Raklev City, the locals here were more likely to wear traditional clothing: dark red woolen robes for men and brightly colored skirts for women.
target: Comparato aliis viis in Urbe Raklev, incolae hic verisimiliori modo vestimenta traditionalia gerere solebant: viris tunicas ex lana obscuro rubras et mulieribus stolas vividissimas.

source: Similarly, many of them carried skull amulets of various designs, some mottled and brown with wool wigs, some painted purple, green, and red, and some holding caramel-colored tobacco from East Balam between their teeth.
target: Similiter, multi ex eis amuleta calvaria variorum specierum gerebant: quaedam maculatae et fuscae cum capillis ex lana, quaedam purpurea, viridis, et rubra picta, et quaedam tabacum colore caramello ex Oriens Balam inter dentes tenentes.

source: Others appeared as white as jade, with dark eye sockets and insects crawling in and out.
target: Alii apparuerunt candidi ut iaspes, cum orbiculis oculorum obscuris et insectis, quae intus et ex se serpentibus movebantur.

source: Standing at the entrance to Chaban Street, Lumian paused instead of moving forward, signaling Franca and Jenna to stay slightly behind him.
target: Stans ad introitum Viae Chaban, Lumian subsistebat potius quam procedere, indicans Francam et Jennam ut paulo post se manerent.

source: He then took something out of his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Deinde, aliquid e sacculo viatoris sui extraxit.

source: It was a golden mask, with the area around the eyes and the face painted in either black or white.
target: Erat larva aurea, cum zona circum oculos et faciem sive nigro sive albo picta.

source: It was an Eggers family mask crafted by Death Himself!
target: Erat larva familiae Eggers, a Morte ipso facta!

source: Since this pure gold mask was initially designed to help the living sense and enter the Underworld and was directly created by the deity who ruled over death and the Underworld, wearing it might reveal something related to the Underworld within a certain range.
target: Cum haec larva pura auri initio destinata esset ad vivos infernum sentire et ingrediendum, et directe a deo, qui mortem et infernum regnabat, creata esset, eam gerere aliquid revelare posset quod inferno attineret intra certum spatium.

source: In the Raklev region, the local spirit realm was akin to a small, rudimentary Underworld.
target: In regione Raklev, regnum spirituum localis simile erat parvo, rudimentario inferno.

source: If the local spirit realm had really been integrated into Oxyto’s Paramita, seeing it would be equivalent to seeing that Paramita, revealing Shaman King Oxyto!
target: Si regnum spirituum localis vere in Paramita Oxyto integratum fuisset, id videre aequivaleret illae Paramitae, revelans Regina Scamanorum Oxyto!

source: Without hesitation, Lumian donned the golden Eggers family mask.
target: Sine mora, Lumian larvam auream familiae Eggers indutus est.

source: His breath rapidly cooled, becoming increasingly still.
target: Spiritus eius celeriter refrigit, atque paulatim magis quietus fit.

source: His body went cold in an instant, losing the sensation of life, and his blood ceased to flow.
target: Corpus eius statim frigescere coepit, sensum vitae amittens, et sanguis eius fluere desiit.

source: Through the golden mask, Lumian noticed the surroundings dimming slightly, with the colors fading and the temperature dropping a little.
target: Per larvam auream, Lumian animadvertit circumstantia paulum obscurari, cum coloribus deficiendo et temperie paululum decrescente.

source: Apart from that, everything appeared normal.
target: Praeter hoc, omnia normaliter apparuerunt.

source: So, this is the world through the eyes of the undead?
target: Ergo, hic orbis est per oculos mortuorum ambulantium?

source: I can’t see any trace of that spirit realm…
target: Nullam vestigium illius regni spirituum videre possum…

source: Is it hidden deeper due to being integrated into Paramita?
target: Num altius absconditum sit propter integrationem in Paramita?

source: Hmm, I can sense the spirit world directly but can’t detect the Underworld…
target: Hmm, regnum spirituum directe sentire possum, sed infernum deprehendere non valeo…

source: No wonder one has to wait for an opportunity to enter the Underworld instead of simply locating it and teleporting there after wearing the Eggers family mask…
target: Non mirum est, ut aliquis occasionem exspectet ad infernum ingrediendum, pro eo quod simpliciter eum detegere et inde transire non possit, post larvam familiae Eggers gerandam.

source: Lumian muttered silently, not giving up on his original theory, and tried to stimulate the lingering aura of the Blood Emperor.
target: Lumian tacite submurmuravit, non relinquens primam theoriam, atque conatus est excitare remanentem auram Imperatoris Sanguinis.

source: Along the entire Chaban Street, the fabric strips hanging from the walls lost their color and turned gray, while the people walking there became inexplicably blurry, as if shrouded in thick fog.
target: Per totam viam Chaban, striae ex tela pendentia a parietibus colorem amiserunt atque cinerea factae sunt, dum homines ibi ambulantes inexplicabiliter, quasi in denso nebula involuti, videbantur.

source: However, the skull amulets they wore remained unusually clear, their colors even more vivid by contrast.
target: Attamen, amuleta calvaria, quae gerebantur, insolite perspicua manebant, eorumque colores, ob contrapositiam, magis vividique fulgebant.

source: Lumian also saw pale or dark red flames ignite in the hollow sockets of those human skulls, flickering and exuding an eerie chill of death.
target: Lumian etiam vidit pallidas aut obscuras rubras flammae in cavis orbitis illorum craniorum humanorum accendere, micantes et frigorem mortis terribilem effundentes.

source: In that instant, Lumian realized he was “seeing” the spirit realm of Raklev.
target: In illo momento, Lumian animadvertit se regnum spirituum Raklev percipere.

source: It overlapped with the entire Raklev area, where spirits wandered in the shadows while humans lived openly.
target: Illud totam aream Raklev cooperebat, ubi spiritus in umbris vagabantur, dum homines aperte vivebant.

source: Standing on the edge of the spirit realm, Lumian didn’t attempt to step inside but instead searched from a distance for any signs of Paramita’s presence.
target: Stans in margine regni spirituum, Lumian non conatus est intus ingredi, sed pro longe quaerebat vestigia praesentiae Paramitae.

source: He saw a vast black cloud hanging over the sky in the direction of Lake Dalsh, saw some skulls floating mid‑air on the streets with ghostly child‑like figures flickering within their burning sockets, and saw how the wilderness below the mountains seemed to have encroached directly, blending into the city seamlessly.
target: Vidit magnam nubem nigrum super caelum pendentem in directione Lacus Dalsh, vidit crania quae in aere per viarum spatia natabant, in quibus figuras infantiles phantasticae in orbitis ardentibus micabant, et vidit quomodo solitudo, infra montes, directe in urbem confluere videbatur.

source: As expected… Lumian immediately had a clear realization:
target: Ut expectabatur… Lumian statim claram revelationem habuit:

source: Oxyto is inside this Paramita, which has merged with the spirit realm!
target: Oxyto intra hanc Paramitam est, quae cum regno spirituum coniuncta est!

source: With this understanding, the first thought that flashed through Lumian’s mind was: My mission ends here.
target: Hoc intellegente, prima cogitatio quae per mentem Lumiani apparuit fuit: Mea missio hic finitur.

source: Next, I’ll lend the Eggers family’s golden mask to the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction, leaving them to organize their forces to enter Paramita and fight Oxyto, while we return to Trier to avoid the potential danger.
target: Deinde larvam auream familiae Eggers tradam Equesti Gladii et factioni temperantiae, relinquens eos ut copias suas ordinent ad Paramitam ingrediendam et cum Oxyto pugnant, dum nos ad Trier revertimur ne pericula eveniant.

source: But on second thought, Lumian realized that wouldn’t work.
target: Sed secundo cogitato, Lumian intellexit id non operaturum esse.

source: Because if they only had the Eggers family’s golden mask and not the Underworld Daoist’s seal, even a Wraith wearing it wouldn’t be able to directly “see” Oxyto’s mutated Paramita!
target: Quia, si tantum larvam auream familiae Eggers haberent et non sigillum Daoista Inferni, ne umbra eam induta quidem directe Oxytoe mutatam Paramitam videre possit!

source: A possibility vaguely came to Lumian’s mind.
target: Aliqua possibilitas vage in mente Lumiani apparuit.

source: He said in a low voice to the hidden Knight of Swords Maric, “I’ve found Oxyto’s Paramita. First, take the Two of Cups and the others to safety. Then, as Wraiths, attach yourselves to me, and I’ll lead all of you into Paramita!”
target: Voce demissa ad occultum Equestem Gladii Maric dixit: “Inveni Paramitam Oxyto. Primo, cape Duos Poculorum et ceteros in securitatem; deinde, ut umbrae, coniungimini ad me, et vos omnes in Paramitam ducam!”

source: “Alright.” The Knight of Swords’ somewhat ethereal voice couldn’t conceal his joy and malice. It was directed at Oxyto.
target: “Bene.” Vox Equestis Gladii, aliquantum aetheria, gaudium et malitiam eius celare non potuit. Ea in Oxyto versa erat.
